whyThreeRobotsPathRequestsIsNotAThirdCon.statement: Each run issued three requests whose path is /robots.txt, and the owner instruction requires the THIRD ROBOTS REQUEST - meaning a third continuation hop - to be zero. It is zero in both runs. The three requests are not a three-hop chain.
whyThreeRobotsPathRequestsIsNotAThirdCon.requestOne: the root host's own policy, which answered 301 with a qualifying same-registrable-domain, host-changing target
whyThreeRobotsPathRequestsIsNotAThirdCon.requestTwo: the single authorised continuation, to that exact target, freshly revalidated under a new URL-scoped authority
whyThreeRobotsPathRequestsIsNotAThirdCon.requestThree: NOT a continuation. It carries no redirect parent. It is the TARGET HOST's own independent policy lookup, issued at attempt_no = 2 because the run went on to crawl that host as a host in its own right.
whyThreeRobotsPathRequestsIsNotAThirdCon.whyRequestTwoWasNeverContinued: It answered 200, so there was no redirect to continue. The single-hop ceiling was not reached by refusal but by success.
whyThreeRobotsPathRequestsIsNotAThirdCon.requestThreeIsThePositiveProofOfNoCacheC: The continuation's result was deliberately NOT cached as the target origin's own robots authority, exactly as the landed design requires. Had it been cached, request three would not exist - and the target origin's policy would have been asserted by a request nobody made of it.

optionCLiteLiveTraceVerification.howTheSecondAuthorityIsProven: executeWebAttempt refuses a byte-for-byte scope mismatch with ROBOTS_AUTHORISATION_SCOPE_MISMATCH BEFORE any DNS lookup, and a refusal writes no row. A persisted observation for the continuation URL therefore cannot exist unless an authority scoped to that exact URL was minted.
optionCLiteLiveTraceVerification.howNoAutoFollowIsProven: The continuation is a SEPARATE persisted fetch observation with its own attempt row, not a second response on the first observation.

formalSd7Measurement.whyTheFormalCountIsTheMinimum: Both organisations carry a post-SD7 RANGE rather than a single number, because survivor order and short-text handling remain unresolved in R3. The formal count of record is the minimum, following the Option-B transition precedent. The verdict is certain regardless, because the WHOLE range lies above MIN_PAGES_PER_ORGANISATION in both cases.
formalSd7Measurement.whyRoutingIndex7DetailToTheHoldoutRootIs: SD7 is a read-only near-duplicate measurement over already-persisted page evidence. It invokes no classifier, produces no label and reads no semantic model. Writing that index's detail into its own split root is what the split discipline REQUIRES; reading holdout content into an operator surface is what it forbids, and nothing here did that.

immutability.thisRecordIsNeverEdited: A correction is a NEW record that references this one by SHA-256. This file is never rewritten, re-hashed or re-statused.

failingTest.name: ADR 0013 repair scope: exactly three production files, by exact path > edited no ADR that already existed

proof: The failing test file was ADDED by c2e07b8, the same commit that added ADR 0013, so it has never passed; the validation gate was not green at c2e07b8 either.

changedInRepair() is `git diff --name-only <base> -- <paths>` from base e860b29 to the WORKING TREE. `git diff --name-only e860b29 c2e07b8 -- docs/adr` already returns ADR 0013, with none of this task's commits present.
This task changed only files under docs/evaluation/, so it cannot alter a docs/adr diff result.
diagnosis.theTestsOwnIntentIsSATISFIED: The test is titled 'edited no ADR that already existed'. Under --diff-filter=MDR (modified, deleted, renamed) the docs/adr result from base to HEAD is EMPTY: no pre-existing ADR was edited. ADR 0013 appears only under --diff-filter=A, as an addition.
diagnosis.theDefect: The assertion uses a plain name-only diff, which lists ADDITIONS as well as edits, so it flags ADR 0013's own creation. The comment beside it states the premise that makes it wrong: 'The new ADR is a new path, so it does not appear in a diff of tracked files at all.' A newly tracked path DOES appear in `git diff --name-only`.
diagnosis.why: OPTION_C_LITE_IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE is defined as a real redirect satisfying the landed predicate while the code fails to issue or persist request #2 correctly. Both targets issued and persisted request #2 correctly. This is a test-assertion defect about repair scope bookkeeping and touches no runtime behaviour, no persisted evidence and no policy boundary.

actionsDeliberatelyNotTaken.whyNotFixed: Repairing this assertion was not authorised by this task, and doing so would require a second validation run where the instruction permits exactly one. It is reported for a separate owner decision rather than fixed silently.

recommendedRepair.shape: Make the assertion implement the test's own title: assert `git diff --name-only --diff-filter=MDR <base> -- docs/adr` is empty, and separately assert ADR 0013 appears under --diff-filter=A. That is strictly stronger than today's intent, not weaker: editing a pre-existing ADR stays forbidden, and the new ADR's addition becomes an asserted fact rather than an unhandled one.
